cendral_matin.title: Cendral
cendral_matin.narrator: On the frontier of Aerith, far from Aurenthal and its lights.
cendral_matin.text:
The sun rises over Cendral.

You sharpen your knife on the doorstep.

It's a habit.
Not for fighting — for the wood.
You've been carving since you were eight.

The village wakes up slowly.

The baker lights her oven.
Children run between the houses.
Old Marek walks his dog, as he does every morning.

Cendral isn't big.
No renowned mages.
No garrison from Aurenthal.

Just a border village, like hundreds of others.

But it's home.

It always has been.

village_calme.title: An Ordinary Morning
village_calme.text:
You set down your knife.

You sit on the low wall of the square.

Cendral has always been like this.
Calm.
Predictable.
Uneventful.

Sometimes you wonder what lies beyond the hills.
The other villages.
The great cities of the kingdom.
The roads you never take.

Old Marek stops beside you.

**"You're daydreaming again."**

**"I'm observing."** you reply.

He laughs.

**"That's what all daydreamers say."**

He walks on.

You look at the hills.

entrainement.title: The Sword
entrainement.text:
You take the sword hanging on the wall.

It belonged to your father.
Plain. Sturdy. No ornament.

Not an elemental blade — just iron.
In Cendral, no one can afford a smith from Aurenthal.

You begin the basic movements.

High strike. Low strike. Parry. Counter.

You've trained alone for years.
No one in Cendral truly knows how to fight.

Just you.

As you strike the training post,
you notice something strange.

Your hands.

A faint violet tint.
Like static electricity.

It vanishes at once.

mains_etranges.title: Something Strange
mains_etranges.text:
You turn your hands over.

Nothing.

Normal skin.
No trace.

You clench your fist.

A spark.
Violet.
Brief.
Real.

In the legends of Aerith,
one color is tied to a single element.

Not water.
Not fire.
Not earth.
Not air.

Chaos.

Caël's name crosses your mind.

You push the thought away at once.

alerte_bandits.title: The Alarm
alerte_bandits.text:
A cry rings through the village.

Then another.

You run toward the square.

Twenty or so armed bandits are coming down the north hill.
On horseback.
Fast.

The villagers flee.
Children are crying.

Old Marek tries to block their path with his staff.

A bandit strikes him without slowing down.

Marek falls.

choices.text: Try to get the villagers evacuated.

evacuation.title: Evacuate
evacuation.text:
You shout at the villagers to run for the forest.

Some listen.
Others are frozen in place.

You grab two children by the hand.
You push them toward the trees.

A bandit blocks your way.

He smiles.

**"Where do you think you're going?"**

Behind you, you hear the houses burning.

Anger rises.
Something rises with it.

In your hands.
In your chest.
Everywhere.

combat_bandits.title: The Fight
combat_bandits.text:
You charge the first bandit.

Your sword against his.

You are faster than they are.
You always knew it.

But there are twenty of them.

You knock down three.
Four.

But the fifth strikes your shoulder.

You fall.

A bandit raises his blade above you.

Behind him, a house collapses.

The baker's child is still inside.

basculement_pouvoir.title: Chaos
basculement_pouvoir.text:
Something breaks inside you.

Not fear.
Not anger.

Something deeper.
Older.

A violet light bursts from your hands.

It tears through the bandit in front of you.
The wall behind him.
The house behind the wall.

You don't control it.

You can't control it.

It's like trying to stop a river with your hands.

The bandits flee, screaming.

But the power keeps going.

And Cendral is in its path.

cendral_detruit.title: The Ruins
cendral_detruit.text:
Silence.

You look around.

Cendral no longer exists.

The houses are ruins.
The bakery.
The square.
The wall where you used to sit.

The villagers are alive.
They had time to flee.

But they watch you from a distance.

With fear in their eyes.

You.

They are watching you.

Then you see it.

In the ashes, at your feet.

A sword.

Black.
It swallows the light around it.
As if darkness were drawn toward its blade.

It wasn't there before.

It is here now.

Old Marek sits in the rubble.
He is looking at you.
He is looking at the blade.

And in his gaze you read something
you will never forget.

He no longer recognizes you.

marek_peur.title: Marek's Gaze
marek_peur.text:
You approach Marek.

He backs away.

Old Marek, who watched you grow up.
Who taught you to carve wood.
Who laughed at your daydreaming.

He backs away from you.

**"Marek... it's me."**

He stares at the black blade in your hand.

His voice trembles.

**"The prophecy..."**

He shakes his head.

**"I didn't know it was you."**

No anger.
Just fear.

**"Not you."**

He stands and walks away without looking back.

quatre_arrivent.title: They Arrive
quatre_arrivent.narrator: They had already been on the road. For days.
quatre_arrivent.text:
You hear them before you see them.

Four horses.
Fast.

They halt at the edge of the ruins.

Four figures dismount.

A girl with silver hair — her sword shines like water.
A boy with a clenched jaw — his blade burns without going out.
A girl with hands covered in earth — her sword is as broad as a boulder.
A boy who smiles — his sword vanishes and reappears in the air.

They look at the ruins.

Then they see the blade in your hand.

The black blade.

Aryn closes her eyes for a moment.

Ikar says something under his breath.

*"It's him."*

Taera puts a hand over her mouth.

Vael no longer smiles.

premiere_rencontre.title: The Five Blades
premiere_rencontre.text:
The silver-haired girl steps forward.

She doesn't touch her sword.

**"Your name is {{player}}."**

It isn't a question.

**"I'm Aryn."**

She gestures to the other three.

**"Ikar. Taera. Vael."**

You tighten your grip on the black blade.

**"You're the Four Blades."**

All of Aerith knows their names.
Their feats.
The statues in Aurenthal.

Aryn nods.

**"We were waiting for you."** she says.

**"Were you expecting this?"** you ask, gesturing at the ruins.

Silence.

Taera lowers her head.

**"We hoped not."**

**"But the prophecy..."** says Ikar.

Aryn cuts him off with a look.

refus_aide.title: Leave Me Alone
refus_aide.text:
They don't move.

Ikar takes a step toward you.

**"This isn't a suggestion."** you say.

A violet spark crackles in your hand.

Ikar stops.

Vael rests a hand on his shoulder.

**"We're not leaving."** says Ikar.
**"Even if you hate us."**
**"Especially if you hate us."**

Taera sits on a piece of collapsed wall,
as if she plans to stay all night.

**"We have nowhere else to go."** she says softly.
**"Neither do you."**

explication_ordre.title: The Order of the Blades
explication_ordre.text:
Aryn speaks.

For a long time.

The Order of the Five Blades has existed for centuries.
Four warriors. Four elements.
And a bearer of Chaos.
Water. Fire. Earth. Air. And Chaos.

**"Chaos is the most powerful."** she says.
**"And the most dangerous alone."**

She pauses.

**"Three hundred years ago... Caël."**

The name falls into silence.

Even here, among the ruins, it weighs.

**"He had received a prophecy."** Aryn continues.
**"That he would destroy everything."**
**"He tried to avoid it."**
**"He isolated himself."**
**"And by isolating himself..."**

She doesn't need to finish.

**"The four sages of the time stopped him."**
**"Not killed."**
**"Stopped."**
**"At the cost of their lives."**

Ikar looks at you.

**"We've trained since we were seven."**
**"So we would never repeat that."**

Vael rolls his eyes.

**"A romantic way of saying we had no choice."**

Taera nudges him with her elbow.

surveille.title: Under Watch
surveille.text:
Aryn doesn't look away.

**"Yes."**

**"For how long?"**

**"Since you were born."**

Silence falls.

Ikar crosses his arms.

**"It's not what you think."**

**"It's exactly what I think."** you reply.

Vael steps closer.

**"We didn't follow you to control you."**
**"We watched over you so we'd be there when it happened."**

He gestures at the ruins.

**"And we were too late."**

In his voice, something like guilt.

pas_prevenu.title: Why Not Sooner?
pas_prevenu.text:
Taera answers.

Gently. As always.

**"We didn't know when it would happen."**
**"The powers of Chaos awaken differently in each person."**

**"Some in adolescence."**
**"Others later."**
**"Some never."**

**"And if you had told me from the start?"**

She considers.

**"Would you have believed us?"**

You have no answer.

Ikar shrugs.

**"Exactly."**

ce_quils_veulent.title: What They Want
ce_quils_veulent.text:
**"What do you want from me?"**

Aryn looks at you for a long moment.

**"To teach you to master Chaos."**

**"And if I don't want to?"**

**"Then Aerith will end up like Cendral."**

Not said cruelly.
Just the truth.

Ikar sits down on the ground.

**"We're not going to force you."** he says.
**"But we're not leaving either."**

Vael pulls something from his bag.
Food.

**"It's going to be a long night."** he says.
**"Might as well eat."**

Taera settles beside the fire she has just conjured.

As if it were normal.
As if they had always done this together.

nuit_ensemble.title: Around the Fire
nuit_ensemble.text:
You sit down.

Vael hands you bread.

Taera's fire burns without wood.
Just heat, wherever she wants it.

**"Have you known each other long?"** you ask.

Vael laughs.

**"Since we were seven."**
**"The Order brought us together."**

**"Did you choose it?"**

Ikar shakes his head.

**"No."**

Taera smiles.

**"But we would have chosen the same."**

A comfortable silence.

The kind you share with people
you've known for a long time.

Except you only met them tonight.

nuit_ecart.title: Alone in the Dark
nuit_ecart.text:
You sit apart from them.

You watch them from the rubble.

They speak to each other in low voices.
Sometimes they laugh.

Vael says something.
Ikar tosses him a piece of bread.
Taera sighs.
Aryn says nothing, but she smiles.

Four friends.

Around a fire.

As if everything were fine.

As if Cendral were not in ruins behind them.

You clench your fists.

They are at ease here.
Too at ease.

As if it had all been planned.

choices.text: Stay in the shadows until you fall asleep.

epees_elements.title: The Swords
epees_elements.text:
Ikar notices your gaze on his blade.

He draws it.

The flame ignites at once.
Orange and blue.
Alive.

**"Every blade is forged by an Aurenthal smith."** says Aryn.
**"Attuned to its bearer's element."**
**"Anyone can have one."**

She draws hers.
Translucent.
Like frozen water.

Taera rests her hand on the hilt of her own.
Moss instantly spreads over the stones around her.

Vael summons his from the air.
Literally.
It materializes out of nowhere.

You look at the black blade in your hand.

**"Mine... no one forged it."**

**"No."** says Aryn.
**"It forged itself."**
**"That hasn't been seen since..."**

**"Since Caël."** says Ikar.

portails_memoires.title: Their Stories
portails_memoires.narrator: Close your eyes. Let go. Trust.
portails_memoires.text:
**"Tell me."**

Aryn looks at you.

**"Our stories?"**

**"How you discovered your powers."**
**"How you came to be here."**

They exchange a glance.

Taera speaks first.

**"It's not a short story."**

Vael smiles.

**"The night is long."**

Aryn rests her hand on her sword.

**"Close your eyes."**
**"We'll show you."**

choices.text: Close your eyes — see Aryn's memory.
Close your eyes — see Ikar's memory.
Close your eyes — see Taera's memory.
Close your eyes — see Vael's memory.
No. You don't feel like letting go.

portail_aryn.title: Aryn's Memory
portail_aryn.text:
You open your eyes again.

The fire crackles.

Aryn is watching you.

**"You saw."**

It isn't a question.

You nod.

Something has changed in the way you look at her.
Not by much.
But something.

portail_ikar.title: Ikar's Memory
portail_ikar.text:
You open your eyes again.

Ikar is watching you.

Still with his arms crossed.
Still with his jaw clenched.

But in his eyes — something you hadn't seen before.

He doesn't ask whether you saw.

He knows you saw.

portail_taera.title: Taera's Memory
portail_taera.text:
You open your eyes again.

Taera has her hands pressed to the ground.

She draws them back gently.

**"The earth says you understand better now."**

She smiles.

Not the smile she wears to reassure.

The other one.

portail_vael.title: Vael's Memory
portail_vael.text:
You open your eyes again.

Vael is crouched in front of you.

He looks at you with his usual smile.

Too light.
Too easy.

Then the smile shifts a little.

**"So."**

**"So."** you reply.

That is enough.

lendemain_matin.title: The Next Day
lendemain_matin.text:
You wake up in the ruins.

Taera's fire has gone out.

They are all there.
Seated.
Waiting for you.

Aryn stands.

**"We leave today."**

**"Where?"**

**"Far from Cendral."** says Ikar.
**"People are afraid."**
**"And as long as you can't control it..."**

He doesn't finish his sentence.

He doesn't need to.

You look at the ruins one last time.

Marek's house.
The bakery.
The wall of the square.

All of it still exists.
Just in pieces.

choices.text: Ask for a little more time.

au_revoir_cendral.title: Goodbye, Cendral
au_revoir_cendral.text:
You walk alone through the rubble.

Marek's house.
You stop before the collapsed doorway.

You pick something up from the ashes.

Your carving knife.
Intact.

You slide it into your belt.

Taera has followed you without a sound.

She rests a hand on your shoulder.

She says nothing.

It is better that way.

depart_cendral.title: The Road
depart_cendral.text:
Four figures on the road.
And you.

The sun rises ahead of you.

Vael walks beside you.

**"First time leaving Cendral?"**

**"Yes."**

**"Not the best start."** he says.

**"No."**

He laughs softly.

On the road, a farmer passes you.

He sees the black blade at your belt.

He steps aside.

His face.

You know this face now.
It is the same as Marek's.

The prophecy goes ahead of you.
Wherever you go.

Ikar walks ahead.
Fast. As always.

Aryn leads.
She knows the way.

Taera is behind.
She looks back at Cendral one last time.

As for you, you look at the black blade.

It absorbs the morning sun.

And you do not yet know
whether it is a curse
or something else.

fin_prologue.title: Prologue — End
fin_prologue.text:
The road to Aerith stretches out before you.

Four blades.
And Chaos.

Together for the first time.

The adventure begins.

journee_marek.title: Marek
journee_marek.text:
Old Marek sits on his usual bench.

His dog Brun sleeps at his feet.

He is carving something from a scrap of wood.
His hands tremble a little now.
But the motion stays precise.

He is the one who taught you.
Long ago.

**"Are you going to stand there, or sit down?"**

He doesn't look up.

conversation_marek.title: A Lesson from Marek
conversation_marek.text:
You sit down.

Marek carves without speaking.

After a while he hands you his piece of wood.

A dog. Small. Not perfect.
But you can tell it's a dog.

**"Brun, when he was young."**

You look at it.

**"It's good."**

**"It's botched."** he says.
**"But it's honest."**

He takes his knife back.

**"A pretty lie is worth less than a crooked truth."**

He says it as if it were self-evident.

Brun opens one eye.
Then closes it again.

choices.text: "Do you know the legends of the Five Blades?"

marek_rumeur.title: The Rumor
marek_rumeur.text:
Marek puts his knife away.

**"Heard anything?"**

**"Like what?"**

**"People from the next village over came through last night."**

He looks at the north hill.

**"They spoke of bandits on the road."**
**"More of them than usual."**

He pats Brun's back.

**"Probably nothing."**

He says it.
But he keeps looking at the hill.

boulangerie_matin.title: The Bakery
boulangerie_matin.text:
The smell of warm bread fills the street.

The baker, Mira, pulls out a batch.

She sings while she works.
Always.
Even alone.

She sees you and immediately sets something on the counter.

A brioche.
Still warm.

**"You still look like you haven't eaten."**

**"I've eaten."**

**"A carving knife isn't a meal."**

She pushes the brioche toward you.

Her son Luc is playing behind the counter.
He is pretending to be a knight with a baguette.

luc_enfant.title: Luc the Knight
luc_enfant.text:
Luc raises his baguette.

**"I am the great knight Luc!"**
**"Defender of Cendral!"**

He charges an imaginary enemy.

The baguette snaps against the wall.

He stares at the two pieces.

**"...I'm still the great knight Luc."**

Mira sighs.

**"That was supposed to be for dinner."**

You laugh.

Luc looks at you with serious eyes.

**"Could you actually fight? For real?"**

You catch Mira's eye.

She smiles without answering.

choices.text: "I would protect Cendral if I had to."

sculpture_bois.title: The Carving
sculpture_bois.text:
You sit on your doorstep.

You take a piece of wood from your stock.

You begin to carve.

No plan.
Just the motion.

The knife lifts away fine shavings.

Something gradually appears.

A dog.

You look at what you have made.

You think of Brun.
Of Marek.
Of Mira, singing.
Of Luc and his broken baguette.

Cendral is small.
Cendral is ordinary.

But every face you know here
has a story.

You know them all.

rumeur_bandits.title: Bad News
rumeur_bandits.text:
A man gallops in from the north road.

He dismounts, shouting.

**"Bandits!"**
**"Twenty of them!"**
**"They're coming!"**

The villagers freeze.

Marek rises from his bench.

Mira grabs Luc by the shoulder.

Everyone's gaze converges on one point.

On you.

Not because you're a warrior.
Because you're the only one with a sword.

endormissement.title: Sleep
endormissement.text:
Taera's fire has sunk to embers.

You lie down on what remains of a wall.

The stars above Cendral.

The same as before.

You close your eyes.

Sleep comes quickly.
Too quickly.

As if your body wanted to flee something.

voix_nuit.title: Voices
voix_nuit.location: Cendral — Ruins — Middle of the Night
voix_nuit.text:
Voices.

Low.
Nearby.

You half-open your eyes.

The four are sitting together, away from the fire.
They are speaking in low voices.

You catch fragments.

**"...no other choice..."**

Silence.

**"...if it gets worse..."**

Ikar says something.
You can't hear it.

Aryn answers.

**"...the elders were right about..."**

The wind swallows the end of the sentence.

Taera shakes her head.

**"...not like Caël..."**

Your name.

You heard your name.

ecouter_suite.title: Snatches
ecouter_suite.text:
You close your eyes.

You listen.

Ikar speaks.
His voice is tense.

**"...we can't wait until..."**

Vael cuts in.
More gently.

**"...it will have to be his choice..."**

**"And what if he doesn't choose?"** says Ikar.

A long silence.

Aryn replies.

Too low.

Too low for you.

But you see Ikar rest his hand on his blade.

Just for a second.

Then he lifts his hand away.

Taera says something that sounds like a question.

Aryn answers in two words.

The four of them fall silent.

Then Vael says something.

They laugh softly.

You don't understand why they're laughing.

choices.text: Close your eyes and pretend you heard nothing.

confronter_nuit.title: What Were You Saying?
confronter_nuit.text:
You stand up.

All four of them stop.

They look at you.

**"What were you saying?"**

A silence.

Vael smiles.

**"We were talking about the stars."**

**"Really."**

**"That one's the Northern Sword."** He points at the sky.
**"And that one is..."**

**"Ikar put his hand on his blade."**

Vael's smile fades.

Ikar looks at you.

**"I had a cramp."**

His voice is flat.
Neither warm nor cold.

Aryn studies you for a long moment.

**"You should sleep."** she says.
**"Tomorrow's road is long."**

Something in her tone.
Not coldness.

Sadness.

nuit_sans_sommeil.title: Eyes Open
nuit_sans_sommeil.text:
You lie down.

Eyes open.

You stare at the stars.

*Not the choice.*
*If it gets worse.*
*The elders were right.*

The phrases spin.

You don't know what they mean.

You build answers.
Each worse than the last.

Maybe this is normal.
Maybe they were talking about something else.

Maybe.

But Ikar put his hand on his blade.

Just for a second.

In the dark, you grip the hilt of your black blade.

It is cold.

Reassuring.

refus_memoires.title: Not Tonight
refus_memoires.text:
Aryn looks at you.

She waits.

You do not close your eyes.

**"Another time, perhaps."**

She nods slowly.

No pressure.
No insistence.

But something in her gaze.

As if she already knew
that another time might never come.

lore_marek_legendes.title: Marek's Legends
lore_marek_legendes.text:
Marek sets down his knife.

He thinks.

**"The Four Blades..."**
**"My father used to talk about them."**

He looks at his hands.

**"In Aurenthal they have statues."**
**"Tall as houses."**
**"I saw them once."**

**"You went to Aurenthal?"**

**"When I was young."** he says.
**"Before Cendral became my life."**

He picks up his wood again.

**"They have a statue of Caël too."**
**"But it's in a cellar."**
**"No one shows it to the tourists."**

He smiles without humor.

**"To remind people."**
**"Not to honor him."**

lore_cael.title: Caël's Story
lore_cael.narrator: Vael tosses a twig into the fire.
lore_cael.text:
**"Caël was your age."** says Aryn.

**"Roughly."**

She gazes at the embers.

**"He lived in a village like Cendral."**
**"On the frontier."**
**"Far from Aurenthal."**

**"Someone foretold his destiny."**
**"That he would destroy everything."**
**"That he was dangerous."**

Taera takes up the story.

**"He tried to leave."**
**"To isolate himself."**
**"To protect the others."**

**"And it killed him."** says Ikar.
**"Not physically."**
**"It killed what he was."**

Vael stares into the fire.

**"Alone with Chaos..."**
**"...Chaos always wins."**

Silence.

**"That's why we're here."** says Aryn.

lore_ordre.title: The Order of the Blades
lore_ordre.text:
**"The Order has existed since Caël."** says Aryn.

**"The four sages who stopped him..."**
**"...their spirits founded the Order."**

**"Their spirits?"**

Taera nods.

**"They died stopping him."**
**"But their spirits stayed."**
**"To train the generations that followed."**

**"They're the ones who found us."** says Ikar.
**"At seven years old."**
**"One by one."**

Vael smiles.

**"They found me stealing apples."**
**"Great destiny."**

Taera laughs in spite of herself.

**"The Order chooses one bearer per element."** says Aryn.
**"Per generation."**
**"We train together."**
**"We wait."**

**"You waited for me?"**

**"Our whole lives."** she says.

lore_prophetie.title: The Prophecy
lore_prophetie.text:
**"Do you really want to know?"**

**"Yes."**

She looks at Ikar.
He shrugs.

**"The bearer of Chaos will come from the frontier."**
**"Born of ordinary pain."**
**"He will burn what he loves most."**

She pauses.

**"And he will choose."**
**"To be the storm."**
**"Or the end of the storm."**

Silence.

**"Is that all?"** you ask.

**"That's all."**

You look at the ruins of Cendral.

*He will burn what he loves most.*

It has already happened.

lore_aurenthal.title: Aurenthal
lore_aurenthal.text:
Vael comes alive.

**"Aurenthal is..."**
**"...a lot."**

**"A lot how?"**

**"A lot of people."**
**"A lot of light."**
**"A lot of everyday magic, everywhere."**

He shows his hand.
A light breeze swirls between his fingers.

**"Here it's rare."**
**"Down there, children do this in the street."**

Ikar looks at him across the fire.

**"And a lot of people who are afraid of Chaos."**

**"Ikar..."** says Taera.

**"It's true."** he says.
**"He deserves to know."**
**"In Aurenthal, Caël's name..."**
**"...you don't say it out loud."**

He looks at you.

**"Yours isn't safe either, now."**

lore_forgerons.title: The Smiths of Aurenthal
lore_forgerons.text:
Taera answers.

**"The smiths of Aurenthal read the element."**
**"In the way you stand."**
**"In your breathing."**
**"In your hands."**

**"They forge the blade accordingly."**
**"It takes weeks."**
**"Sometimes months."**

**"Can anyone have one?"**

**"Anyone who can pay."** says Ikar.

**"And yours?"**

Aryn looks at her translucent blade.

**"Ours are different."**
**"The spirits of the old masters forged them."**
**"Before we were even born."**
**"They were waiting for us."**

She hesitates.

**"Yours..."**
**"...no one forged it."**
**"It was born from Chaos itself."**
**"It's the first time since Caël."**

You look at the black blade.

It absorbs the light of the fire.

prevenir_village.title: Warning the Village
prevenir_village.text:
You make the rounds of the village.

The blacksmith.
The baker.
The families.

**"Bandits on the north road."**
**"Stay indoors tonight."**

Some nod.
Others shrug.

Bandits happen.
In Cendral, as anywhere else.

Mira pokes her head out of the bakery.

**"Thank you for warning us."** she says.
**"Luc, go inside."**

Luc protests.

**"But Mom—"**

**"Inside."**

He goes inside.
